summary:
w173 (supervision#r98): reviewed one commit, b6c4feb1. It has the same content as 1860fabe, the commit the implementer's result lists, merged again onto the line. The branch work/w173 is gone.
The change adds a 'Reviewer's findings: <last k-review/findings.md>' line to implement briefs, only on the done->awaiting-answer->ready route, which is what r98 asks for. The @r98 scenario passes.
No test was removed or weakened, nothing under features/ changed, and the report lists no allowances.
Two Minor observations: (1) findings_lines parses log.jsonl itself and crashes on a line that is not JSON, where workqueue.logged would skip it, and the plan said to use that helper; (2) the line names findings.md even when the file is missing.
Cannot verify: the end-to-end route, because work answer still returns a reviewer's question to done (w174 / r26 was withdrawn).
tools check: one ruff error and one vulture warning, both in lines the commits do not touch. tools size: nothing over 300 lines.
